newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: New Toyo's public offer 22.39 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: New Toyo's public offer 22.39 times subscribed.

text.p: The public portion of New Toyo International Holdings Ltd's new share offering has been subscribed 22.39 times, the company said on Thursday.
New Toyo had offered 54 million new shares comprising 43.2 million offer shares and 10.80 million placement shares at Singapore $0.80 each.

The maker of specialised paper products and packaging materials said in a statement there were 846.18 million applications for the 37.80 million shares offered to the public. The placement shares and those reserved for employees and associates were also fully taken up, it said.
Trading of the shares on a "when-issued" basis is expected to begin on April 4 and on a "ready" basis on April 16.
The company said it planned to use the net proceeds of about S$40.20 million to finance new business ventures and for working capital.
